meta.title: Ido Safra — Speaker & Workshop Facilitator for Resilience, Communication & Personal Growth
meta.description: Talks and workshops for organizations, teams and managers on mental resilience, stress and anxiety, communication and habit change. NLP Master, workshop facilitator, author and podcast host. Every session is tailored to the organization's needs.
meta.ogDescription: Talks and workshops for organizations and teams: mental resilience, stress and anxiety, communication and habit change. Practical tools for immediate use.

waIntro: Hi Ido, I'd love to hear about the session

about.title: Speaker and program facilitator for resilience, communication and personal growth
about.introLead: I believe in the power of
about.introRest: to drive practical results. Over the years I've guided hundreds of people, teams and organizations on a journey toward mental resilience, effective communication and high performance — even under pressure and in crisis.

creds.title: Deep experience with people and organizations
creds.text: Nearly a decade of leading teams and people in command and management roles. I facilitate and support problem-solving within teams, strengthen collaboration, and build a healthy, growth-oriented work environment.

creds.title: External relations and relationship management
creds.text: Extensive experience building trust with clients, partners and senior stakeholders. Interpersonal communication that leads to influence and results.

creds.title: Specializing in NLP and positive psychology
creds.text: Combining practical tools from the world of NLP, a deep understanding of human behavior, and hands-on approaches to building resilience, self-confidence and realizing potential.

distinct: Precisely tailored to the organization's needs
A blend of depth, inspiration and practical tools
An experience that leaves a mark and leads to real results
about.value: A bridge between strategic thinking, human leadership and practical tools — so people and organizations can perform at their best, even amid pressure, change and uncertainty.

offerings.lede: Every talk and workshop combines practical tools, an interactive experience and immediate application you can take to work and life the very next day. Sessions sometimes include live demonstrations with people from the audience.
offerings.note: All lectures and workshops can be delivered as live online sessions

items.title: The control is in your hands
items.text: A hands-on workshop for coping with stress and anxiety. Practical tools to manage your mental state, regain control and find immediate relief.
items.who: Employees, teams, managers, students and anyone dealing with stress

items.title: Language creates reality
items.text: Recognizing and understanding our different identities, and working with the masks we wear. Inner and outer clearing on the path to self-realization.
items.who: Teams, managers, therapists, and anyone who wants to grow and fulfill their potential

items.title: You are not your habit
items.text: A workshop on changing habits and working with the fears that hold us back. Breaking through the blocks and habits that slow us down.
items.who: Employees, managers, teams, and anyone who wants to grow personally

items.title: From crisis back to routine
items.text: An empowerment and enrichment workshop for reserve soldiers and anyone navigating the return to routine after periods of combat and emergency.
items.who: Reserve soldiers, security forces, teams and organizations

items.title: Limiting beliefs
items.text: How limiting beliefs undermine our achievements and quality of life — and how to identify and change them.
items.who: Managers, teams, students and anyone seeking change and growth

items.title: Writing as a therapeutic tool
items.text: A practical workshop on using writing to process emotions, clarify goals and drive personal growth and change.
items.who: Education, therapy, teams, communities and anyone who wants to go deeper

items.title: Willpower — how does real willpower actually work?
items.text: What is true willpower? How to activate it correctly, persist, and achieve what matters to us. Includes a live demonstration with someone from the audience.

items.title: Stress and anxiety — where do they come from?
items.text: Understanding the sources of stress and anxiety in body and mind, practical tools for effective coping, and group practice.
items.who: Organizations, teachers and educators, students and pupils

items.title: The map is not the territory
items.text: How our interpretation of past events shapes us in the present — and how changing that interpretation opens up new possibilities for life.
items.who: The general public, therapists, teams and organizations

items.title: The critic in your head: there is no failure — only feedback for growth
items.text: What is failure, really? How the voices that limit us stop us from taking action — and how to let them go.
items.who: Managers, teams, students and anyone who wants to grow

items.title: Confidence amid uncertainty
items.text: Strengthening inner resources and abilities, and practical techniques for creating certainty even when the uncertainty around us is great.
items.who: Organizations, teams, managers, and people in an era of change

items.title: The emotion beneath the pain
items.text: Understanding the link between emotion and pain. Innovative therapeutic approaches that can bring relief and even resolve chronic pain.
items.who: The general public, and people suffering from chronic pain

process.title: What working with me looks like

steps.title: Intro call
steps.text: A short, no-obligation conversation. Together we understand what's on the organization's — or your — mind, and check that there's a connection, because connection is half the work.

steps.title: Precise mapping
steps.text: We identify the patterns running behind the scenes: where they came from, and how they affect day-to-day life and performance.

steps.title: The session itself
steps.text: A talk or workshop with NLP tools, live demonstrations and practice — not theory, but an experience you can use as early as tomorrow.

steps.title: A clear way forward
steps.text: You don't leave with insights alone. You walk away with precise steps and change you can feel at work and in life itself.

items.quote: I too want to thank you for the chance to take part in the workshop — it was absolutely right for me. You give it your whole being; you have a wonderful ability to read people and communicate with them well, and above all you love what you do and it shows immediately. Anyone who comes to you will benefit. Thank you, thank you, and I'm sure we'll see and hear a lot more from you!
items.author: Workshop participant

items.quote: You deserve even more, Ido. Thank you for the professional and empowering guidance — you contributed so much to my personal growth and deepened my understanding. You're patient, helpful and generous with your time for the person in front of you; there's no such thing as a "long process" with you — you manage to lead a person to their goal and shift their thinking quickly. Today wasn't an end point but a starting point. A huge thank you, Ido.
items.author: Workshop participant

items.quote: Dear Ido, you managed to create something special here — I hope you're aware of it.
items.author: Workshop participant

items.quote: What a joy to read about everyone's personal growth here! An amazing group — it's not a given that we got to know each other and opened up like this in just six sessions!
items.author: From the workshop group

items.quote: Five sessions of magic and insight — you gave us a gift from the heart. With NLP tools and precision of thought, you guided us to grow out of love. Thank you for the time you devoted with kindness and generosity — we deeply appreciate the guidance and dedication!
items.author: Thank-you note from workshop participants

credo.quote: I believe that real content can change lives.
credo.highlight: The principle that guides me is honesty — and getting to the point.
credo.closing: I want the people who work with me to feel held, understood, and confident enough to move forward.

impact.lede: Real change doesn't end when the talk is over. It continues through words, conversations, ideas and stories that stay with people long after the session ends.

book.title: Binding Reality
book.subtitle: A psychological thriller novel
book.description: My debut novel, based on true events. It deals with coping with trauma, choice, meaning, hope, and a person's ability to break free from the past and create a new future for themselves.
book.quote: "Sometimes the greatest prison is inside our own thoughts."
book.note: Available as an e-book from Ivrit Publishing
book.coverAlt: Cover of the book Binding Reality

podcast.subtitle: Podcast
podcast.description: A podcast on personal growth, NLP, mindfulness, psychology, spirituality, religion, and practical ways to create meaningful inner change.
points: In-depth conversations with professionals, therapists and researchers
podcast.quote: That's why I keep creating beyond the hall too — in writing, in the podcast, and in conversations that keep inspiring long after the session ends.
